bhubaneswar.orientation: Choose between temple architecture, Dhauli, a craft collection and the city’s painted memories. Leave time for lunch.
story: Mukteswar’s carved stone, the Jain caves at Udayagiri and Khandagiri, and the Buddhist monuments at Dhauli belong to different histories. Seeing them together can make Bhubaneswar seem like one continuous ancient city. Its modern capital has another beginning: architect Otto Königsberger planned it. A temple and a street plan need different questions.

Start with the place that interests you most. At Mukteswar, take time to look at the arch before moving to the temple. Give Dhauli its own visit. The painted streets in my February 2009 photographs offer a third way into the city, through public art as it looked then. They are an archive to browse, not a route of murals known to survive today.

coastal_food.sweet_finish: The Puri guide also points visitors towards chhena poda: a browned edge and a softer centre. Ask when it was made and which ingredients were used. It is a dairy sweet; recipes and additions can vary.
